'''26''' ('''twenty-six''') is the [[natural number]] following [[25 (number)|25]] and preceding [[27 (number)|27]].

== In mathematics ==
26 is a [[composite number]]. 26 is also a [[Telephone number (mathematics)|telephone number]], specifically, the number of ways of connecting 5 points with pairwise connections.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeis.org/A000085|title=Sloane's A000085 : Involution numbers|website=The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences|publisher=OEIS Foundation|access-date=2021-12-03}}</ref>

=== Group theory ===
There are 26 [[sporadic group]]s.<ref>{{Cite book|last=Wilson|first=Robert|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=lYMAg_Sj7hUC&q=26+sporadic+groups.&pg=PA183|title=The Finite Simple Groups|date=2009-12-14|publisher=Springer Science & Business Media|isbn=978-1-84800-987-5|pages=183|language=en|quote=In this chapter we introduce the 26 sporadic simple groups.}}</ref>

The 26-dimensional Lorentzian [[unimodular lattice]] [[II25,1|II<sub>25,1</sub>]] plays a significant role in [[sphere packing]] problems and the [[classification of finite simple groups]].

== In religion ==
* 26 is the [[gematria|gematric]] number, being the sum of the Hebrew characters ({{langx|he|יהוה}}) being the name of the god of Israel – [[Tetragrammaton|YHWH]] (''Yahweh''). 26 is also the gematric number for GOD with the corresponding substitutions in English (i.e. A=1, B=2, C=3, and so on)
* In the [[Tenrikyo]] religion of Japan, 26 is frequently used, since it marks the lunar calendar date of its founder [[Nakayama Miki]]'s first divine revelation and also her death.
